chapters.screen: Random Forest. A single deep tree is jagged. A random forest grows many trees, each on a different bootstrap sample of districts, and averages them. Watch the jagged single tree turn into a smooth, stable curve as trees are added.
chapters.spoken: Random Forest. A single deep tree is jagged. A random forest grows many trees, each on a different bootstrap sample of districts, and averages them. Watch the jagged single tree turn into a smooth, stable curve as trees are added.

chapters.screen: Each dot is one California district: median income (x) and median house value (y). Showing 900 of the 12,384 districts the model trains on.
chapters.spoken: Each dot is one California district: median income and median house value. Showing 900 of the 12,384 districts the model trains on.

chapters.screen: One tree on its own bootstrap sample: jagged, because small leaves chase local noise. Validation RMSE $86k.
chapters.spoken: One tree on its own bootstrap sample: jagged, because small leaves chase local noise. Validation root mean squared error 86 thousand dollars.

chapters.screen: Each frame adds already-fitted trees and re-averages. Nothing is optimised here: faint teal lines are the newest single trees, the blue line is the average of all.
chapters.spoken: Each frame adds already-fitted trees and re-averages. Nothing is optimised here: faint teal lines are the newest single trees, the blue line is the average of all.

chapters.screen: 50 trees: train RMSE $79k, validation $84k (one tree alone: $86k). Averaging cancels out what the trees disagree on.
chapters.spoken: 50 trees: train root mean squared error 79 thousand dollars, validation 84 thousand dollars (one tree alone: 86 thousand dollars). Averaging cancels out what the trees disagree on.

chapters.screen: For an unseen district every tree casts a vote (its own prediction); the forest reports the average of all the votes.
chapters.spoken: For an unseen district every tree casts a vote (its own prediction); the forest reports the average of all the votes.

chapters.screen: Final exam: the trained model prices all 4,128 test districts it has never seen, a batch at a time. The map shows where it misses: blue = worth more than predicted.
chapters.spoken: Final exam: the trained model prices all 4,128 test districts it has never seen, a batch at a time. The map shows where it misses: blue means worth more than predicted.

chapters.screen: A forest averages many trees' terraces, so the sheet is a staircase of many small steps. Same algorithm, now given house age as well as income; height is its predicted price.
chapters.spoken: A forest averages many trees' terraces, so the sheet is a staircase of many small steps. Same algorithm, now given house age as well as income; height is its predicted price.

chapters.screen: Seven more inputs cut the typical error from $84k to $55k.
chapters.spoken: Seven more inputs cut the typical error from 84 thousand dollars to 55 thousand dollars.

chapters.screen: Averaging many over-fitted, slightly different trees cancels their individual noise: lower variance, better predictions. Limitation: the forest is slower and far less readable than one tree, and like every tree model it cannot predict beyond the prices it has seen.
chapters.spoken: Averaging many over-fitted, slightly different trees cancels their individual noise: lower variance, better predictions. Limitation: the forest is slower and far less readable than one tree, and like every tree model it cannot predict beyond the prices it has seen.
